_comment: Curated external resources for /packet/resources/. Verify links before each season.

links.name: CyberPatriot Cisco training materials
links.desc: The official page for the Cisco Networking Challenge. Check it first every season. The module unlock table lives or dies here.

links.name: CyberPatriot training materials (all)
links.desc: Windows, Linux and Cisco training modules together.

links.name: Cisco Networking Academy
links.desc: Where the 23-module content course lives. Every competitor is enrolled. This site is scaffolding around that reading, not a replacement for it.

links.name: Networking Basics scope and sequence (PDF)
links.desc: The public curriculum reference our module titles are reconstructed from.

links.name: Cisco Packet Tracer download
links.desc: Get the same version the team runs. Device models and menus move between releases.

links.name: Cisco IOS command reference
links.desc: When you need to know whether a command is real.

groups.name: Suggested video sources
groups.note: Places worth pulling from when filling videos.json. Nothing here is endorsed sight-unseen. Watch it before you assign it.

links.name: Jeremy's IT Lab, Free CCNA complete course
links.desc: The most thorough free video series in this space. Aimed above our scope, so pull individual videos, not the whole playlist.

links.name: Cisco Networking Academy on YouTube
links.desc: First-party, matched to the course vocabulary.

links.name: Practical Networking
links.desc: Best-in-class explanations of ARP, routing, and the packet-travel sequence, directly on U4/U5.
